contract.geometry: Grain-aligned cylinder grid with discrete chord-corrected unit yarns. Same cut and half-throw as original prism seed.
contract.limitations: No native tightening, physical material calibration, local thickness or swept proof. Removes mesh slivers, not every possible solver failure.
contract.old_seed: Original clipped seed remains archived in RibbonGridSeed/previous_ribbon_knot_seed.json on publish.

construction.formula: t=40-u for A,t=u for B; X=A*(t-20)+C*v; YZ=R*(cos(B*t+D*v),sin(B*t+D*v)), negated for B. A and D solve discrete chord-length equations.

separation_bounds.proof: Use |principal angular separation|<=pi*YZdistance/(2R), eliminate t from X=A*t+C*v and angle=B*t+D*v. Opposite phases force numerator A*pi-width*|A*D-B*C|. Linear triangle interpolation differs from the smooth cylinder by at most R*(B*DU+D*DV)^2/8; subtract twice. No local sheet-thickness or sweep exemption follows.

expected.material_metric: Exact discrete warp/weft edge lengths; normalized triangle shear is nonzero and soft.
expected.topology_scope: Same three negative half-throw events and four open ends; not final RobeTie port placement.

settings.handles: u=40; diagnostic exit direction from final centerline edge
settings.bending_model: Initial faceted cylinder is not a rest-crease prescription.
settings.start_relaxation: Yarns and pinned rows valid at start; initial soft shear is not at constitutive equilibrium with lambda0, so relax before accepting a physical resting seed.
